headline.en: Software engineer building AI- and data-driven products
headline.id: Software engineer yang membangun produk berbasis AI & data

subheadline.en: Informatics student at Telkom University with hands-on experience in web development, data engineering, analytics, and software quality assurance.
subheadline.id: Mahasiswa Informatika Telkom University dengan pengalaman langsung di pengembangan web, data engineering, analitik, dan software quality assurance.

bio.en: I am an Informatics student at Telkom University who builds AI- and data-driven software. Through three internships I have worked across web development, data engineering, analytics, and software quality assurance.
bio.id: Saya mahasiswa Informatika Telkom University yang membangun perangkat lunak berbasis AI dan data. Lewat tiga kali magang, saya terlibat di pengembangan web, data engineering, analitik, dan software quality assurance.

bio.en: I am looking for software engineering and AI engineering roles where I can keep growing and ship products that people actually use.
bio.id: Saya mencari peran software engineering dan AI engineering untuk terus berkembang dan merilis produk yang benar-benar dipakai orang.

highlights.en: AI-powered web app with vision AI and an LLM chatbot (WealthWise)
highlights.id: Aplikasi web berbasis AI dengan vision AI dan chatbot LLM (WealthWise)

highlights.en: Log-based Change Data Capture pipeline from PostgreSQL to Greenplum
highlights.id: Pipeline Change Data Capture berbasis log dari PostgreSQL ke Greenplum

highlights.en: QA background: test plans, API testing with Postman, regression testing
highlights.id: Latar belakang QA: test plan, pengujian API dengan Postman, regression testing
